preview.editLocal: Edit with an app on this PC
drop.badTarget: Cannot copy to this tab (only a connected SSH or local terminal)
conn.autoReconnectDesc: Retries up to 5 times at growing intervals of 2, 4, 8, 16 and 30 seconds
conn.restoreLayoutDesc: Saves open tabs and pane layout on exit and reconnects to the same servers next time. Passwords and screen contents are not saved, and one-off SSH connections not in the list are not restored
conn.sessionLogDesc: Saves terminal output to text files (open connections start recording when you turn this on)
conn.logKeepDaysHelp: Session log files older than this many days are deleted automatically. 0 keeps them forever.
conn.logSyncSecHelp: How often a log being recorded is flushed all the way to disk (0–5). File Explorer shows the file size and modified time only after such a flush. 0 writes and flushes every piece of output immediately, which increases disk load. Otherwise output is written to the file every second.
conn.logTimestampDesc: Prefixes each recorded log line with [date time.milliseconds]. It is written to the file only, not shown on screen (changes apply from the next line)
conn.logAnsiDesc: Writes the log exactly as received, without removing ANSI control codes such as colors and cursor movement. When off (default), only the text is kept. View such a log with cat or less -R in a terminal to see the colors (changes apply from the next output)
backup.importBody: Your current server list and credentials will be replaced with the backup contents. Continue?
backup.imported: Backup imported. Unlock with the app lock password from the PC that made the backup.
backup.desc: One backup file holds the server list, settings, snippets and {encrypted} credentials. Import it on another PC and open it with the same app lock password.
files.intro: Paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V or drop files into an SSH terminal: they are uploaded to the server upload folder and the path is typed into the terminal. CLIs on the server such as Claude Code read the image from that path. Example: type What causes the error on this screen? and press Ctrl+V.
files.uploadDirHelp: Server path for uploaded files. ~ is the home directory; it is created if missing.
files.cleanupHelp: Deletes uploads older than this many days. Only files uploaded by DariTerm (dt- prefix) are affected; 0 turns it off.
files.tempDir: Temp folder for server-to-server copies (this PC)
files.tempDirHelp: Server-to-server copies are first downloaded to this PC folder, then uploaded to the target, and the temp files are deleted afterwards. Leave empty to use the OS temp folder.
files.zmodemDesc: In an SSH or serial terminal, running sz file downloads it to this PC, and running rz sends the files you pick. Useful behind jump servers or on devices without SFTP. Press Ctrl+C to cancel a transfer.
files.zmodemDir: Folder for files received over ZMODEM (this PC)
files.zmodemDirHelp: Leave empty to save to the Downloads folder. If a file with the same name exists, it is not overwritten; (2), (3)… is added to the name.
input.copyOnSelectDesc: Selecting text by dragging copies it to the clipboard immediately (PuTTY style)
input.rightClickPasteDesc: When off, right click opens a menu. Even when on, Shift+right click opens the menu
input.ctrlVPasteDesc: When off, Ctrl+V is sent to the server as is, and you paste with Ctrl+Shift+V
input.shiftEnterDesc: Starts a new line without running. For multi-line input in CLIs such as Claude Code (sends the same as Alt+Enter)
input.osc52: Allow the server to write the clipboard (OSC 52)
input.osc52Desc: Applies clipboard write requests from tmux, vim, Claude Code, etc. on the server to this PC. Read requests are always refused
input.confirmMultilineDesc: Confirms before running when pasting two or more lines
input.guardProd: Warn about dangerous commands on production
input.guardProdDesc: On servers with environment 'Production', asks first before running or pasting a command that matches the patterns below (regular expressions)
input.patterns: Dangerous command patterns (regex, one per line)
about.proprietary: Proprietary software · Copyright © 2026 YangHun Lee (kai). All rights reserved.
about.termsLine: Free for personal use · Business use needs a per-user business license
about.ossDesc: Open source components included in this program and their license texts.
about.updateCheckDesc: Checks for new releases at startup and every 12 hours. No server list, IP or credentials are sent; if it cannot check (e.g. offline network) it skips silently
about.updateCheckStoreDesc: Checks the Microsoft Store for a new version at startup and every 12 hours. When one is available, use the button in the status bar to confirm the update. Your server list, IP addresses and account details are never sent.
sec.autoLockHelp: Locks the app after this much inactivity or when Windows locks or sleeps. Connected sessions stay open. 0 turns it off
sec.osUnlockDesc: Unlocks with the current Windows account (DPAPI) instead of the app lock password
sec.pwMin: The new password must be at least 8 characters
sec.pwMismatch: The new passwords do not match
cred.deleteUsed: {count} servers will ask for the password again when connecting.
sync.nogit: git is not installed on this PC.
sync.mismatch: The encrypted data in the repository differs from this PC
sync.credInUrl: Do not put passwords or tokens in the repository address — the git credential helper/SSH keys of this PC are used
sync.overwriteBody: The synced contents in the repository will be replaced with this PC’s data. Other PCs must fetch again with the new app lock password.
sync.intro: Keeps the server list in sync across PCs. Only one file encrypted with the app lock password goes to your private git repository; no plain text is stored. Open it on other PCs with the same app lock password. Repository authentication uses this PC’s git setup (SSH keys, credential helper); the app does not store git credentials.
sync.repoHelp: e.g. git@github.com:me/dariterm-sync.git — do not put passwords or tokens in the URL
sync.autoDesc: Syncs when you unlock, about 20 seconds after a change, and every 10 minutes
sync.mismatchHelp: On a new PC choose "Get repository data"; to make this PC the source, choose "Overwrite with this PC’s data" (existing repository contents are replaced).

tab.broadcastOff: Turn off broadcast input for this tab
tab.broadcastOn: Broadcast input to all panes in this tab

paste.multiBody: Pasting {lines} lines into [{name}]. Each line may run as a command.

hk.connectAnyway: Accept the risk and connect with the new key
hk.changedBody: [{session}] The host key of {host} differs from the saved one. Unless the server was reinstalled or its IP changed, this may be a man-in-the-middle attack. If unsure, do not connect.
auth.failed: Wrong password or authentication failed. Please try again.
auth.save: Save encrypted and sign in automatically next time
auth.keyProtected: The key file is protected with a passphrase

sftp.emptyCopy: This folder is empty. Drop files here to copy them.
sftp.emptyUpload: This folder is empty. Drop files here to upload them.
sftp.editHint: Saving after editing uploads to the server automatically

sftp.deleteDirNote: Folders are deleted with all their contents.

sftp.unsupported: The file panel is available only for SSH and local terminal sessions.
sftp.waitConnect: The file list appears once connected.
folder.envHelp: Servers in this folder inherit this environment color

shell.linkOn: Broadcast input on — input goes to every visible pane

shell.linkOffTitle: Broadcast off — click to type into all visible panes
shell.imageTipLocal: Saves the clipboard image on this PC and types its path (to attach images in CLIs such as Claude Code)
shell.imageTipServer: Uploads the clipboard image to the server and types its path (to attach images in CLIs such as Claude Code)
shell.dropSplit: Drop here to split left and right
sb.deleteFolderMove: Delete folder "{name}"? Servers inside move to the parent folder.
sb.folderServersBody: Also delete all {count} servers in folder "{name}" (including subfolders)?
sb.folderServersDetail: [No] deletes only the folder and moves the servers to {where}. [Cancel] deletes nothing.
sb.selectedHint: Drag to move into a folder · Right-click to delete

lock.newMin8: The new password must be at least 8 characters
lock.title: DariTerm is locked
lock.overlayDesc: Your sessions stay connected. Enter the app lock password to continue.
lock.desc: Enter the app lock password to open your saved server credentials.
lock.forgot: Forgot the password? Reset with recovery code
setup.title: DariTerm setup
setup.desc: Server IDs, passwords and keys are encrypted with AES-256 using this app lock password and stored only on this PC. The app lock password is never sent anywhere.
recovery.title: Recovery code
recovery.desc: If you forget the app lock password, only this code can recover it. Print it or write it down somewhere safe. You cannot see it again after closing this screen.
recovery.saved: I saved the recovery code somewhere safe
recover.title: Reset password with recovery code
recover.desc: Enter the 24-character recovery code you got when creating the app lock password, and a new password. Saved credentials are kept.
import.awsNone: No AWS instances found to import
import.awsFailed: AWS lookup failed: {error} — check your credentials with aws configure in a terminal
import.crtNone: No SecureCRT sessions found in the selected folder
import.crtFailed: Could not read the SecureCRT folder: {error}
import.intro: Reads PuTTY saved sessions (registry), SecureCRT session folders and <k>~/.ssh/config</k>. Host, port, user, key file, port forwarding, serial settings and encoding are carried over. Passwords are not; enter them once on first connection and they are saved.
import.lockedNote: (key files are not saved while the app is locked)
import.awsNote: Reads instances with your aws CLI credentials. Private-IP servers connect through a bastion in the same VPC as the jump server, and keys are looked up in ~/.ssh/<key name>.pem.
import.crtNote: Reads SecureCRT sessions from another location (e.g. a Config folder copied from another PC). The folder structure is recreated under the target folder.
import.noneNote: There are no saved PuTTY/SecureCRT sessions and no ~/.ssh/config.
import.folderHelp: Names starting with prod-/stg-/dev- get the Production/Staging/Development environment automatically. Leave empty to import at the top level. SecureCRT folder structure is created under this folder.
fwd.help: L: a port on this PC → an address reachable from the server (e.g. local 3307 → DB 3306). R: a port on the server → an address on this PC's side. D: opens a port on this PC as a SOCKS proxy; connections from programs using that proxy go out through the server (the program chooses the destination).
serial.echoDesc: Turn on if the device does not echo typed characters
serial.flowHelp: RTS/CTS sends input only while the device asserts CTS; XON/XOFF sends only while the device has not sent XOFF. Input the device cannot accept for more than 2 seconds is discarded.
jump.addressHelp: Entering user@host:port splits it into user, host and port
host.savedChange: Saved — type a new one to change it
host.alias: Display name (shown in tabs and lists)
host.startDirHelp: Leave empty to open in the home folder
host.envHelp: Production servers get a red border and ask before running dangerous commands
host.color: Color (follows the environment/folder color if not set)
host.lockedNotice: The app is locked. Unlock it first to save passwords or keys.
host.savedCredHelp: Servers using the same account share one password. Changing it applies to all of them.
host.pwSavedHelp: A password is saved. Type a new one to change it.
host.pwEmptyHelp: Leave empty to be asked on first connection, where you can choose to save it.
host.keyPasteHelp: Supports OpenSSH, PEM and PuTTY PPK (v2 and v3). Key contents are stored encrypted.
host.agentNote: Uses the OpenSSH agent and Pageant on Windows, and the SSH_AUTH_SOCK agent elsewhere. If agent authentication fails, you are asked for a password.
host.askNote: Asks for the password on every connection. Choose "Save" in the prompt to sign in automatically next time.
host.jumpHelp: A server to go through before connecting to this one (ProxyJump).
host.tmuxDesc: Programs inside tmux keep running even if you close the pane or app, and reopening reattaches to the same screen.
host.tmuxWsl: On local Windows, only WSL shells are supported.
host.tmuxNeed: tmux must be installed on the target.
host.tmuxNameHelp: Leave empty to use the server display name (or local folder name)
host.proxyHelp: When the server cannot be reached directly (for example behind a corporate firewall), the SSH connection is made through this proxy.
host.agentFwdDesc: Lets this server use the keys held by the SSH agent on this PC (OpenSSH or Pageant), for example to ssh or git from the server to another server. The server's administrators can also use those keys while you are connected, so enable this only on servers you trust.

be.session.tmuxMissing: tmux is not available on this target, so the session is not kept (startup command not run)

be.err.auth: Authentication failed (check user name, password or key)

be.ssh.hostKeyRejected: The host key was not accepted (host key rejected)

lic.keyInvalid: The license key is not valid

lic.whereToEnter: Enter the license key in Settings > About. This notice appears once at startup and the program keeps working.

lic.domainBody: This PC is joined to a company domain. If you use DariTerm for work, please switch to Business (license after a 30-day evaluation). This check happens only on this PC; nothing is sent anywhere.

lic.trialOverLong: Business evaluation has ended (no license key)
lic.keyHelp: The key is verified on this PC only and never sent anywhere. Its contents are signed, so any change makes it invalid.
proxy.userHelp: Fill in only if the proxy requires a login. Leave empty to connect without authentication.
proxy.jumpNote: This proxy is not used while a jump server is selected. If the jump server itself must be reached through a proxy, set the proxy on the jump server.
be.proxy.auth: The proxy rejected the user name or password
hl.title: Keyword highlighting
hl.help: Colors these words when they appear in terminal output. Rules higher in the list win. Only the display changes; copied text and logs are not affected. Nothing is highlighted inside full-screen programs such as vim.
be.zm.pick: ZMODEM send: choose the files to send (cancel to stop the transfer)
be.zm.remoteCancelled: The server side stopped the ZMODEM transfer
be.zm.noDir: Cannot determine a folder for received files
be.zm.noName: Too many files with the same name; cannot choose a name to save as
